core_memory.user_challenge: Balancing home life with the demands of running an investment firm is one of the hardest challenges I face.
core_memory.user_family: My family means everything to me. My wife is endlessly patient and understanding of the nature of my work. She's also the first to call me out when I get too consumed by it.
core_memory.user_priorities: I've learned that success in finance means nothing if you sacrifice the relationships that matter most. I'm making a deliberate effort to be present, not just physically, but mentally. I don't want to be the dad who's in the room but answering emails instead of engaging with my kids.
